input.question: In dbt-core functional tests, what must be done before calling `get_manifest(project.project_root)` or `get_artifact(project.project_root, 'target', 'manifest.json')` to ensure the manifest data is available?

options.A: `run_dbt(['compile'])` (or `run_dbt(['parse'])`) must be called first within the same test method to generate the manifest in the target directory
options.B: `get_manifest()` itself triggers compilation internally, so no prior `run_dbt` call is required
options.C: A `conftest.py` autouse fixture must call `run_dbt(['compile'])` once at the class level before any test method runs
options.D: The `project` fixture automatically generates the manifest when it is initialized, so no explicit command is needed
